selections.rationale: Strong governed-AI platform signal with clear architecture ownership; more concise and less jargon-heavy than the alternate.
Connects platform adoption, commercialization, and forecasting without adding the alternate's unsupported partner-deal phrasing.
Clearly links regulated workflow trust to concrete evaluation, telemetry, and rollback controls in a disciplined line.
Preserves the protected six-month-to-three-week metric and attributes it directly to lifecycle standardization without excess detail.
Provides stronger technical specificity through AWS and Databricks while retaining a coherent high-availability architecture claim.
Combines the protected 8-to-28 team-growth metric with commercialization and operating-model impact in a concise leadership bullet.
